tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: ATX Granite King's posted prices, what they include, service area and contact details.

tools.name: estimate_job
tools.description: Estimate total cost from countertop square feet: install at the posted rate plus slabs. Assumes about 75% of each slab is usable.

tools.name: search_stones
tools.description: Search granite, quartz, quartzite, marble and other slabs currently on the Austin yard, including $999 Budget Collection slabs.

tools.name: get_stone
tools.description: Full details for one stone by slug (from search_stones).

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Whether ATX Granite King serves a city or town, and whether pricing changes there.

tools.name: visualize_kitchen
tools.description: Render a slab from the Austin yard onto a photo of the user's own kitchen or bath, and return the image with a price estimate. Pass a public image URL of the room (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and a stone slug from search_stones. Rendering takes about 30-90 seconds; if it is not ready in time, call get_visualizat

tools.name: get_visualization
tools.description: Status and image for a visualize_kitchen job.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a countertop quote request to the ATX Granite King crew. Only call this when the user explicitly asks to be contacted and has given their own phone or email.
